title: Upper & lower limb · online-paper screenshots (33 items)
note: Thirty-three distinct numbered prompts in a 9-page combined screenshot PDF. A separate 19-page lower-limb export repeats the same lower-limb concepts with shuffled choices; retained as related source, not another sitting. Institution/date unconfirmed.

questions.prompt: Regarding clavicle, all are correct EXCEPT:
options: It is first bone to ossify in fetal life
questions.note: Clavicle is a modified long bone with predominantly intramembranous ossification.
questions.subject: anatomy

questions.prompt: Which lies between superior and inferior gemelli?
questions.note: The obturator internus tendon lies between the gemelli.
questions.subject: anatomy

questions.prompt: Which unlocks the knee?
questions.note: Popliteus initiates unlocking rotation.
questions.subject: anatomy

questions.prompt: Which tubercle separates fibularis longus and brevis tendons?

questions.prompt: Medial boundary of femoral triangle is:

questions.prompt: Iliotibial tract receives insertion of:

questions.prompt: Most common clavicular fracture site is:

questions.prompt: Which crosses superficial to flexor retinaculum?
